guidance: {"kind": "procedure_guidance_v2", "procedure": "Select up to five evidence fragment IDs for the acting agent from supplied long task memory, current short context and current request. Return IDs only. The program copies those exact source fragments to the actor. Prefer task identity together with relevant status, priority, changed requirements or feedback. Neighboring fragments may belong to one record. Do not generate an action or translate tasks into tools. Empty selection is allowed. Original requests and feedback govern; remembered claims can be wrong. Focus: Select records relevant to the current request, incomplete authorized work, and recent changes."}
update: {"kind": "procedure_update_v2", "procedure": "Write MEMORY.md as compact JSON with mission and tasks. Each task is a distinct request INSTANCE. Use these task fields: task_ref, request, status, evidence, priority, remaining_components, resume_context. task_ref is a public request ID, or originating event and location; keep that reference across pauses. request is the user-authorized outcome, status is pending/partial/completed/cancelled/uncertain, evidence cites the originating user event or actual execution feedback. Use null for unknown values. Only feedback for this same instance changes its completion status. Similar descriptions do not merge new requests into old completed requests. Continuation resumes existing authorized work; it is not a new request by itself. User revisions supersede only the affected requirement. Preserve outstanding work when compressing: copy each still-authoritative requirement, explicit order/priority, cancellation, and verified partial/completed state into the corresponding task; do not replace an explicit order with vague wording or merge distinct component statuses. Apply newer feedback only to its same task/requirement, while retaining unaffected requirements and evidence. Keep historical details concise. HISTORY.md remains within the same shared total budget, never a second unbounded task list. No private evaluator facts. Retention focus: Preserve current mission and task identities, verified progress, incomplete work and authoritative changes."}
